facts.text: Through the Magician Advantage loan repayment program, LeMoyne-Owen College helps repay up to $80,000 in student and parent loans for eligible incoming freshmen earning $45,000 or less after graduating.

sources.title: Magician Advantage - LeMoyne-Owen College
sources.quote: Starting with the 2025–26 academic year, all admitted, incoming freshmen with a 2.5 GPA or higher will be eligible for the program. The Magician Advantage provides students and families with a financial safety net by helping repay up to $80,000 in federal student, private alternative, and parent PLUS loans if graduates earn $45,000 or less annually.
